description_target.target_text: exact local smoothing of blue/cyan boundaries

racket_target.raw_code:
(rule!
 ;; A blob has one-cell DENTS (notches: 3 blob neighbors, walled
 ;; flanks) and one-cell BUMPS (warts/hairs that pruning weak cells —
 ;; degree <= 1, to fixpoint — strips away). Each mark reflects
 ;; straight through the clean body: a dent paints a fg cell just past
 ;; the far side, a bump erases the far edge cell on its line.
 (lambda (g)
   (let ()
     (define bg (mode g -1))
     (define fg
       (find-first (lambda (v) (not (= v bg))) (grid-colors g -999)))
     (define bmask (cellmap g (r c v) (if (= v fg) 1 0)))
     (define (in? mask r c) (= (safe-at mask r c 0) 1))
     (define (nb mask r c)
       (count-if (lambda (d) (in? mask (+ r (first d)) (+ c (second d))))
                 cardinal-deltas))
     (define dents
       (filter
        (lambda (p)
          (let* ((r (first p)) (c (second p))
                 (miss (filter (lambda (d)
                                 (not (in? bmask (+ r (first d))
                                           (+ c (second d)))))
                               cardinal-deltas)))
            (and (not (in? bmask r c))
                 (= (length miss) 1)
                 (let ((o (first miss)))
                   (all? (lambda (pd)
                           (and (in? bmask (+ r (first pd))
                                     (+ c (second pd)))
                                (not (in? bmask
                                          (+ r (first pd) (first o))
                                          (+ c (second pd) (second o))))))
                         (if (zero? (first o))
                             (list (list -1 0) (list 1 0))
                             (list (list 0 -1) (list 0 1))))))))
        (grid-positions g)))
     (define clean  ;; dents filled, then weak cells pruned to fixpoint
       (let strip ((mask (paint-cells bmask dents 1)))
         (let ((weak (filter (lambda (p)
                               (<= (nb mask (first p) (second p)) 1))
                             (find-color mask 1))))
           (if (null? weak) mask (strip (erase-cells mask weak 0))))))
     (define (walk r c dr dc)  ;; ride clean to its far edge cell
       (if (in? clean (+ r dr) (+ c dc))
           (walk (+ r dr) (+ c dc) dr dc)
           (list r c)))
     (define bump-acts  ;; blob cells the pruning removed
       (filter (lambda (x) x)
               (map (lambda (p)
                      (let ((att (filter (lambda (d)
                                           (in? clean (+ (first p)
                                                         (first d))
                                                (+ (second p)
                                                   (second d))))
                                         cardinal-deltas)))
                        (and (= (length att) 1)
                             (append (walk (first p) (second p)
                                           (first (first att))
                                           (second (first att)))
                                     (list bg)))))
                    (filter (lambda (p)
                              (not (in? clean (first p) (second p))))
                            (find-color bmask 1)))))
     (define dent-acts
       (filter (lambda (x) x)
               (map (lambda (p)
                      (let ((ext (filter (lambda (d)
                                           (not (in? clean
                                                     (+ (first p)
                                                        (first d))
                                                     (+ (second p)
                                                        (second d)))))
                                         cardinal-deltas)))
                        (and (= (length ext) 1)
                             (let* ((o (first ext))
                                    (end (walk (first p) (second p)
                                               (- (first o))
                                               (- (second o)))))
                               (list (- (first end) (first o))
                                     (- (second end) (second o))
                                     fg)))))
                    dents)))
     (for/fold ((out g)) ((a (append bump-acts dent-acts)))
       (set-cell out (first a) (second a) (third a))))))
